title: Hinomori Shizuku — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As part of MORE MORE JUMP!'s birthday stream for Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We present the “Birthday Special: Let Shizuku eat whatever she wants♪” segment!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Haruka
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<The birthday stream started! Happy birthday, Shizuku!>
<Happy birthday, Shizuku!>
<Beautiful as ever... Thank you for existing!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The comments are already flooding in.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for all of your birthday wishes. I'll be sure to read each and every one of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Since it's Shizuku's birthday today and the segment is self-explanatory... We'll be letting her eat her favorite food, tofu skin, to her heart's content!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We went with this idea as per Shizuku's request.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. The girls asked me what I'd like to do, and after giving it some thought...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I realized that I'd be happiest eating my favorite food with my favorite people. So that's what I requested.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<W-What a g-goddess...>
<She said I'm one of her “favorite” people!!!>
<I'm only ever going to eat tofu skin from now on.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
We won't be eating just any regular tofu skin.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We will actually be serving tofu skin dishes made from the recipes we received from our fans!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll be reading out their messages as well as their recipes. I hope you're looking forward to them, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I am! Thank you so much for the recipes and messages, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Without further ado, here is our first message.
This appears to be from a girl in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I wonder what she wrote.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'll read it out.
“Dear Shizuku. Happy birthday.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Watching MORE MORE JUMP! streams always cheers me up. I especially like how you work so hard.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “A little bit ago, I wasn't able to do back hip circles no matter how much I practiced. I almost wanted to give up...”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “But then I saw you doing your best during dance practice, and that made me want to keep trying!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “After I continued to practice, I eventually learned to do back hip circles! Thank you, Shizuku!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh my! She must've been practicing day after day. Congratulations, that's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
There's more.
“I remember you said that you drink miso soup during practice, so my mom and I came up with a tofu skin miso soup recipe.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “There's ginger in it, which will help keep your body warm. The weather will be getting colder, so please enjoy this miso soup and keep working hard!” And that's the end of the message.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She even remembered that I drink miso soup during practice. Also...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: To think that I was able to give someone the push they needed... That makes me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for the miso soup recipe and the lovely message!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I still have a long way to go as an idol... But I'm going to keep working hard so that I can be a source of strength for others. I hope you'll keep watching.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was beautiful...>
<Seeing you work hard always cheers me up too, Shizuku!>
<You're my daily source of energy...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, and this is the miso soup we made using that recipe!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow... It smells so lovely!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here you are. Be careful, it's super hot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Airi. I'll try it now.
*Blow*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It tastes absolutely wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The tofu skin is diced so finely. This would make it easy to drink during practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The recipe actually said to dice the tofu skin into small pieces to make it easier to drink during breaks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate all of the thought you've put into this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm definitely going to make this and bring it to my next practice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now that your heart and body are warmed up from the nice miso soup, let's move on to the next message.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! This time, I'll do the honors!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Dear Ms. Hinomori, happy birthday. I have been your fan since you were in Cheerful * Days.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “I was sad to hear you retired from Cheerful * Days, but I've been very happy to see you appear on TV again lately!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “I also have a friend who discovered MORE MORE JUMP! after watching one of those programs. The two of us are now fans of all of you, so please keep doing your best!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's the end of the message!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see... I apologize for making you feel sad at the time.
Thank you so much for choosing to continue supporting me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And now you and your friend are both fans of us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have been receiving a lot more opportunities to have more people watch us lately. I'm glad to hear that people have been getting to know who we are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All of us will keep working hard so that even more people can come to know about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I hope you and your friend will keep watching over us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, I'll read out their recipe!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, we ate quite a bit!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We sure did. It's a shame that we couldn't make all of the dishes from the recipes we received...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll be sure to read all of your messages and try the recipes we weren't able to include in today's stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Truly, thank you so much.
Getting to celebrate my birthday with you all has just made me the happiest.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I'm glad we were able to celebrate with you!>
<I wish it was your birthday every day...>
<Happy birthday, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
Well then, I'm sad to say goodbye, but that brings us to—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not the end!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, there's one last thing we'd like to present.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe♪
Here's your special birthday dessert, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's adorable! Is this...a snow rabbit?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It's a tofu skin mille-feuille in the shape of a snow rabbit. We also have a voice message from the people who made it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A voice message?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. Now let's give it a listen!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: <On three, everyone! One, two...three!>

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika, Honami & Kohane
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: <We heard that you wanted to eat tofu skin, so we all came up with a recipe and made a tofu skin mille-feuille.>

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: <We used strawberry sauce for the eyes and matcha powder for the ears so that everything would be edible.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: <I know you might feel bad eating it, but...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: <We're confident that it's going to taste great. Please don't worry and enjoy it to the fullest!>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: <Oh, by the way, we also made this with S! They said they're not gonna say anything because voice messages are embarrassing, though...>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: <Anyway, the important thing is that we've put all of our love for you into the cake!>

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: <I understand you've been busy with work, but I hope we can spend more time together sometime.>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: <We'll be continuing to root for you! That's it from us. A message from five of your juniors to our beloved Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: These voices...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. That means “S” must be Shii.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This snow rabbit must've been Shii's idea.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The snow rabbit is so, so, soooo cute!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That's pro quality right there.>
<It feels like such a shame to eat it.>
<Run, rabbit, run!!!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This snow rabbit is very adorable and I can understand why you would feel bad eating it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes... But everyone put so much thought into making this. I'll be sure to savor every bite.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't expect a surprise like this. Thank you, my five juniors! This makes me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well then, I think it's about time to wrap this up.
How about some final words from the star of the day?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd love to.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all for being here today for my birthday, everyone. I had such a wonderful celebration.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really felt all of your thoughts and affection in your messages and recipes. I'm truly and utterly grateful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Being able to receive your messages like this always gives me strength.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, once again...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for everything, from the bottom of my heart.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh no, I'm gonna cry.>
<She's too radiant...>
<No, thank you from the bottom of my heart!!!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I, Shizuku Hinomori from MORE MORE JUMP!, will continue to work hard and spread hope to others.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I hope you will all be there to watch me. I'll be counting on your support.
